description: A classic three-circle Hidden Mickey appears as three small depressions on a red spider ornament. The depressions align on the ornament's body in a way that reads as the classic shape once you spot it.

whereToLook.scene: Two window displays on the right side just outside the lobby exit doors leading toward the villa walkway
whereToLook.exactSpot: Second display: tall totem pole with a colorful bird at the top. Look on the bird's chest area at the red spider ornament for three small depressions forming the shape.

bestTip: Scan the second window display slowly and get close enough to see texture details. This one is more 'texture-based' than outline-based.

viewing.notes: Glass reflections can hide it. Move slightly left or right to reduce glare.
